title: From kidneys to body tissues: Desperate Iranians put organs up for sale as war drags on
content: Iran's deepening economic crisis has driven residents to advertise organs, including kidneys, bone marrow and liver, to pay debts and meet basic expenses. An Iran International investigation of over 600 Telegram listings found widespread multiple-organ offers, highlighting growing financial desperation. The crisis is worsening amid US sanctions, a naval blockade and regional conflict. Economists warn prolonged restrictions could severely affect oil revenues, inflation, public salaries and essential supplies, despite Tehran rejecting economic collapse concerns.

'560% above known income': Lokayukta uncovers Rs 7.6 crore 'empire' of forest officer
content: Lokayukta's Special Police Establishment conducted raids on government official Sanjeev Kumar Sharma's properties after receiving information. They discovered assets valued at approximately Rs 7.6 crore, exceeding known income by 560%. The operation led to the recovery of significant amounts of cash, gold, jewellery, silver, and vehicles. Property documents were also seized for further investigation into potential land transactions. A case was lodged against Sharma under the Prevention of Corruption Act.

title: Google CEO congratulates SpaceX; says 'still feels like science fiction '
content: Sundar Pichai congratulated SpaceX for achieving its first midair catch of a Starship spacecraft after its return. The historic event took place at SpaceX’s Starbase in Texas following the spacecraft's successful re-entry. Starship had completed 14 laps around Earth and deployed advanced Starlink satellites during its flight. Despite the success, a first-stage booster explosion occurred shortly after liftoff during the tests.

title: Telangana BJP chief demands Rahul Gandhi's apology over democracy remarks
content: N Ramchander Rao expressed strong disapproval of Rahul Gandhi’s remarks on India’s democracy during the Bharat Summit, asserting that such comments discredit our democratic institutions. He noted Gandhi's role during the Emergency period and also criticized a foreign delegate's meddling in Indian affairs, calling it a threat to sovereignty. Rao suggested that external financial influences might be motivating Gandhi to stir unrest regarding the upcoming 2024 Lok Sabha elections.

title: Mother leaves £1.1m to son over daughter's lack of love; judge rejects suit
content: The death of Dervishe Halil ignited a significant family dispute regarding a £1.1 million inheritance. Her will, established in 2018, notably left out her children Aysel and Attila. Aysel disputed the will, asserting that Dogan, her brother, had improperly swayed their mother's decision. However, the court validated the will and dismissed accusations of coercion, leading to Dogan inheriting the full estate, while Attila receives a smaller share.

title: Mumbai builder ordered to refund flat booking amount with 9% interest

The buyer's request followed a denied home loan from banks. Despite the builder citing a non-refundable policy, the Commission found no compelling evidence to support forfeiture.

title: 'Law on our side': Karnataka minister's big remark amid Mekedatu Dam row
content: Karnataka minister Priyank Kharge said the law supported the state's proposed Mekedatu dam project, stressing that both Karnataka and Tamil Nadu must follow the Supreme Court's directions. The remarks came amid BJP accusations of Congress double standards over opposition to the project in Tamil Nadu. Karnataka maintains its right to build the reservoir to meet Bengaluru's drinking water needs and generate hydroelectric power, while protecting Tamil Nadu's Cauvery water share.

title: Kohli hits 11-year low as India suffer another batting collapse in New Zealand

title: $3.2m inheritance fight: Maryland court orders new hearing for two sisters
content: A Maryland appeals court has made a pivotal decision by reversing a jury's ruling in an inheritance battle involving three sisters. After the passing of Seyedkazem Amini-Nejad, one daughter inherited the estate, but her younger siblings contended that language barriers impacted their comprehension of the estate's legal documents. This ruling emphasizes the legal standards for interference claims, allowing the sisters a renewed chance to contest the inheritance.

title: Five generations share September 14 birthday; US family sets world record
content: The Harlow family boasts a remarkable legacy, with five generations sharing the same birthday, September 14, since 1907. This cherished tradition continues with the birth of Arthur Bell in 2025, further solidifying their record in the Guinness World Records for the most generations born on the same day. Each year, this family eagerly celebrates their extraordinary heritage, showcasing the strength of familial bonds across time.
